newsitem.title: POLAND: Handlowy extends gains in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Handlowy extends gains in lower trade.

text.p: Poland's Bank Handlowy SA rose 1.3 percent to 40.5 zlotys on Thursday but turnover fell for the first time since the stock started trading on Monday at 37.9 zlotys, 8.3 percent above issue.

Handlowy's turnover fell to 56.2 million zlotys from 110.9 million on Wednesday but analysts said the stronger buying after price-fixing suggested the stock could extend gains toward its Global Depositary Receipt price (GDR).

The 9.75-million-share retail tranche of the bank's May-June offering was three times subscribed and the 19.5-million-share institutional tranche was 17.4 times subscribed with foreign demand over $3.5 billion.
The 24-percent long-term investor tranche went to JP Morgan, Zurich Insurance and Swedbank.
